constraints.name: jobs_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((salary_min IS NULL) OR (salary_max IS NULL) OR (salary_min <= salary_max)))

constraints.name: jobs_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((salary_min IS NOT NULL) OR (salary_max IS NOT NULL)) AND (salary_currency IS NOT NULL) AND (salary_period IS NOT NULL)) OR ((salary_min IS NULL) AND (salary_max IS NULL) AND (salary_currency IS NULL) AND (salary_period IS NULL))))

constraints.name: jobs_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'draft'::text) AND (published_at IS NULL) AND (active_until IS NULL) AND (last_confirmed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status <> 'draft'::text) AND (published_at IS NOT NULL) AND (active_until > published_at) AND ((last_confirmed_at IS NULL) OR (last_confirmed_at >= published_at)))))

constraints.name: jobs_task_content_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((employment_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'task'::text) OR (working_time IS NULL)) AND ((salary_period IS DISTINCT FROM 'task'::text) OR (NOT (employment_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'task'::text)))))
